page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a baseline frequency of 3.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring reliance on network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. The lack of integrated local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a tradeoff, positioning the instance primarily for non-graphical, network-dependent workloads.

Given its high resource density and balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.g9i.48xlarge is designed for large-scale general-purpose workloads. It is highly suitable for enterprise applications, web serving fleets, container orchestration, and distributed microservices. The dedicated hardware allocation ensures predictable performance, offering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive parallel processing without the overhead of specialized GPU or local NVMe storage.
